Separate page when: The homepage must route several distinct audiences or services
Combine when: The business has one offer and one primary action
Acceptance check: A first-time visitor can identify the offer location and next action

Separate page when: Several services share the same audience evidence and enquiry action
Acceptance check: Every listed service links to enough detail for a decision

Separate page when: The service has its own problem evidence process and enquiry details
Combine when: It repeats the same promise and proof as the overview
Acceptance check: The page answers coverage process and what to include in an enquiry

Separate page when: The list changes the visitor decision and can be maintained
Combine when: It is a short supporting fact for the repair service
Acceptance check: Only currently supported brands and appliance types appear

Separate page when: The business has useful verified information about a real operating area
Combine when: The same coverage statement serves every visitor
Acceptance check: Coverage is accurate and avoids thin locality copies

Separate page when: The team process credentials or facilities need meaningful explanation
Combine when: A concise proof section answers the question on Home
Acceptance check: Every claim can be verified and every image is permitted

Separate page when: The enquiry needs instructions fields availability or alternatives
Combine when: A phone email and simple action are enough on another page
Acceptance check: The action works on mobile and keyboard and reaches the authorised destination

Separate page when: A policy is required for the data or transaction handled
Combine when: A short notice can accurately sit beside the relevant form
Acceptance check: The published text matches the actual data handling and business process
